en_title: PlayStation Handheld May Have Exclusive Next-Gen AMD Graphics, Report Suggests
cn_title: 消息称索尼掌机或独占AMD新架构
subtitle: 掌机芯片之争
opus_summary: Digital Foundry称，索尼可能为潜在的PlayStation掌机独占AMD的RDNA 5架构。目前尚无协议获确认，作者认为其他设备最终也会采用该架构。

paragraphs.en: Sony may have exclusive access to AMD's next-generation graphics architecture for a potential PlayStation handheld, the tech experts at Digital Foundry have said.
paragraphs.cn: Digital Foundry的技术专家表示，索尼可能会为一款尚未确定推出的PlayStation掌机，独家采用AMD的下一代图形架构。

paragraphs.en: There have been rumors of a next-generation PlayStation handheld for some time now, after the success of the Nintendo Switch and a wide gamut of PC gaming handhelds . Indeed, in June, Sony Interactive Entertainment CEO Hideaki Nishino suggested PlayStation may move towards more hybrid, Switch-like consoles in the future to match modern on-the-go players.
paragraphs.cn: 在任天堂Switch和各类PC游戏掌机取得成功后，关于下一代PlayStation掌机的传闻已经流传了一段时间。今年6月，索尼互动娱乐首席执行官西野秀明确实曾暗示，PlayStation未来可能会更多地转向类似Switch的混合形态主机，以适应如今玩家随时随地游玩的需求。

paragraphs.en: When I watched the latest Patreon-exclusive DF Direct , Digital Foundry's Richard Leadbetter claimed that "there's been some behind-the-scenes discussion that Sony has an exclusive of sorts with AMD for RDNA 5 for handheld," and that the only other, presumably handheld, chip he knows of in production at AMD is what's going to be known as Z3, which is unlikely to have RDNA 5 graphics.
paragraphs.cn: 我在观看最新一期Patreon独占节目DF Direct时，听到Digital Foundry的Richard Leadbetter表示：「有一些幕后消息称，索尼与AMD就掌机采用RDNA 5达成了某种独占安排。」他还说，据他所知，AMD正在生产的另一款芯片只有未来将被称为Z3的产品，推测也是用于掌机，但不太可能采用RDNA 5图形架构。

paragraphs.en: AMD and Sony have been working closely for the last couple of years, teaming up on an initiative called 'Project Amethyst,' which ultimately resulted in both PSSR 2 on the PS5 Pro and FSR 4.1 for PC and Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 过去几年，AMD与索尼一直密切合作，共同推进名为「Project Amethyst」的项目，最终带来了PS5 Pro上的PSSR 2，以及面向PC和XBOX的FSR 4.1。

paragraphs.en: Speaking of Xbox, it sounds like Microsoft has handheld gaming plans of its own. Project Helix will include a whole range of devices , we were recently told, and a handheld will reportedly be the first out the gate. Fortune recently reported that Microsoft plans to release a handheld by holiday 2027, with the next-gen console following in 2028. The chips going into either of these platforms hasn't been confirmed, but AMD did come out and tease that FSR Diamond would be launching with Project Helix – of which the handheld is a part of – and that would likely be running on RDNA 5.
paragraphs.cn: 说到XBOX，微软似乎也有自己的掌机游戏计划。我们最近获悉，Project Helix将涵盖一系列设备，据称率先推出的会是一款掌机。《财富》近期报道称，微软计划在2027年假日季前推出一款掌机，下一代主机则将在2028年推出。这两个平台采用的芯片都尚未确认，但AMD确实曾透露，FSR Diamond将随Project Helix一同推出，而掌机也是该计划的一部分。FSR Diamond很可能会基于RDNA 5运行。

paragraphs.en: AMD would have reason to supercharge its handheld chip offerings for a wide range of devices, as well. Intel's Panther Lake handheld chip launched at Computex 2026 and, at least in my testing, absolutely bodies the AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme . The Z2 Extreme only uses an RDNA 3.5 GPU, which was already an older architecture when it launched last year. The Intel Arc G3, on the other hand, uses the same GPU that powers its latest laptops, just with a few of the CPU cores disabled.
paragraphs.cn: AMD也有理由大幅提升旗下掌机芯片的性能，以服务各类设备。英特尔的Panther Lake掌机芯片在Computex 2026上发布，至少在我的测试中，它的表现完全碾压AMD Ryzen Z2 Extreme。Z2 Extreme仅采用RDNA 3.5 GPU，去年推出时，这就已经是较老的架构了。相比之下，英特尔Arc G3采用的GPU与其最新笔记本电脑相同，只是禁用了几个CPU核心。

paragraphs.en: With how expensive handhelds have become lately, the whole category is in danger of vanishing until the RAM crisis abates , and so it's possible that Sony's handheld is the only one that springs for the added cost of RDNA 5. But, unless Sony inks some kind of exclusive deal with AMD, I am sure other devices using RDNA 5 will exist eventually – maybe even Xbox's own first-party handheld.
paragraphs.cn: 最近掌机的价格越来越高，在内存危机缓解之前，整个品类都有消失的危险。因此，索尼掌机有可能是唯一愿意承担RDNA 5额外成本的产品。不过，除非索尼与AMD签订某种独占协议，否则我确信，最终还会有其他采用RDNA 5的设备出现，甚至可能包括XBOX自家的第一方掌机。

paragraphs.en: This isn’t the first PlayStation handheld tease, either. Last year, Moore’s Law Is Dead reported on an unannounced PS6 handheld that would be dockable and backwards compatible with PS4 and PS5 games. There was also a brief mention of what was described as a PS6 S, which sounded like it could be to the PS6 what the Xbox Series S is to the Xbox Series X. If true, you’d assume it would be a cheaper option.
paragraphs.cn: 这也不是第一次出现有关PlayStation掌机的消息。去年，Moore’s Law Is Dead曾爆料一款尚未公布的PS6掌机，称其支持底座连接，并向下兼容PS4和PS5游戏。爆料中还简短提到了一款被称为PS6 S的设备，听起来它与PS6的关系，可能类似于XBOX Series S与XBOX Series X的关系。如果消息属实，想来它会是价格更低的选择。
